## Deviations / notes
- Devin TUI required two Enter keypresses per submitted input in tmux (first Enter appeared to be consumed by the input field; second submitted). All sends were retried identically.
- F17 prompts sent as single-line text with identical field content (multi-line pastes unreliable in tmux).
- gpt-6-astra self-report refusal recorded verbatim above; export's `powered_by` is the authoritative-looking field and disagrees with the self-report.

## Orchestrator verification of F17 (session DB `message_nodes`, session `steel-text`)

Query: assistant nodes whose content contains `MODEL=You are powered` → four distinct `message_id`s, each duplicated across chain snapshots with an identical `generation_model`:

| turn | message_id | `generation_model` (verbatim in node metadata) | content self-report |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 — fresh Fusion parent | `1b3a7c80` | `claude-fable-5-1-high` | `powered by Fusion …`, `SIDEKICK=YES` |
| 2 — after `/model adaptive` (TUI `✓ Model set to Adaptive`) | `ed9f29bf` | **`kimi-k2-7`** | still `powered by Fusion …`, `SIDEKICK=YES`, `sidekick` in TOOLS |
| 3 — after `/model fusion-…` | `d7947247` | `claude-fable-5-1-high` | `powered by Fusion …`, `SIDEKICK=YES` |
| 4 — `devin -r steel-text --model adaptive -p` | `810ee739` | **`swe-1-7-medium`** | still `powered by Fusion …`, `SIDEKICK=YES` |

Reading: the mid-session and resume `--model` switches **did** change the generating model (Adaptive routed to Kimi K2 in turn 2 and SWE-1.7 Medium in turn 4, consistent with #1058 F2 where Adaptive resolved to `kimi-k2-7`). The `You are powered by …` system line and the tool list the model reports are **not refreshed** by the switch. Whether the `sidekick` tool remained *callable* after the switch was not exercised (no tool call was made in those turns) — unknown. `sessions.model` lagged: it stayed `fusion-…` through the in-session switches and only became `adaptive` after the `-r … --model adaptive` resume.
